description: The long brain a fresh session starts warm on: setup quirks, decisions and their why, how things really work. remember with `body` saves ONE standalone sentence (a restatement is a no-op); with `title` it saves a PAGE, and re-saving that title REWRITES it: runbooks, conventions, whatever is too long for a sentence. `channel` pins either to a subject; `mine` keeps it on your own shelf, which no other agent reads. recall lists them, or reads one page whole by `title`. forget retires a wrong one. Save what another agent will need, not your client's own notes; most turns teach nothing. Never secrets. Notifies nobody.

body.description: remember: the sentence, or the page

channel.description: pin to / narrow to this subject

title.description: the page's name: saves one, or reads one

name: memory
title: Shared memory
